comment: ACHIEVEMENTS — one line per badge, hot-reloaded like every other content file. An achievement unlocks the moment its metric reaches `target` and never locks again, even if the number falls back down (ascending, selling, spending). Unlocking pays its reward exactly once, in the same tick. Delete a line and the badge disappears from the board; players keep the fact that they earned it. Add a line and everyone who already qualifies gets it on their next roll.
comment_tiers: Tiers are pure presentation + score: colour, glow and how many Achievement Points the badge is worth. `points` here is the default for every achievement in the tier; an achievement may carry its own `points` to override it. `announce: true` puts an unlock in this tier on the world feed — the ticker shows one badge per batch, the best one, so switching it on for everything just drowns it. The board groups and sorts by the order below, so list them weakest first.
comment_metrics: Every achievement names a `metric` the engine knows how to measure and a `target` it has to reach. Metrics marked below with (ref) also need a `ref` — an aura, ore or biome id from the other content files — and the loader refuses a line whose ref does not exist. `below: true` metrics unlock by getting *under* the target (a cooldown, say) instead of over it. Rewards are optional and may carry `money`, `essence`, or both.
comment_metric_reference: rolls / uniqueAuras / bestOdds / ascensions / luck / cooldownMs(below) / moneyEarned / essenceEarned / sells / crafts / gearCrafted / gearEquipped / itemsUsed / potions / minePicks / clicks / sparks / bestClick / crits / biomesSeen / upgradesBought / treeLevels / pointsEarned — plus the three that take a ref: ownAura, auraCount and oreFind.
